name: Your notification settings
description: One entry per category this account can receive, in a fixed order, each with the switch for the site (`app`), the stored push preference, whether the site switch may be turned off (`locked`) and, for `matches` alone, how much of the ladder to hear (`level`). A competitor who never changed anything reads the defaults, because the defaults are not stored: notification_settings_of() folds notification_category_spec() over whatever rows PATCH has written, so a default changed in the migration reaches everyone who never touched that category. `admin` appears only while the account's role is admin, read off the live row as every admin route reads it. Push is a preference only; nothing here delivers one.

input.query: SELECT ls.sid AS session_ok, json_build_object('settings', notification_settings_json(ls.user_id)) AS body FROM live_sessions ls WHERE ls.sid = ($2)::uuid AND ls.user_id = ($1)::uuid
